purpose: Teach: 腹痛/蒸し暑い/暖炉/オムツ/饅頭/日陰/雨水/プロポーズ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、テスト前、絶対、腹痛、絶対、起こすことあるよね
lines.en: Riku, you seriously always get stomach aches right before tests, don't you?
lines.style: Dry, knowing tone. Quick clip on the accusation — she's caught him in a pattern. Slight smirk underneath, affectionately exasperated.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。今日、本気で、絶対、蒸し暑い、絶対、から、絶対、部活、絶対、きついぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Today's so humid and muggy it's killing me, and club practice just makes it worse.
lines.style: Accepting, a little deflecting. Softer than defensive. Admits the pattern without drama. Slight weariness on the tail.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 山小屋で、本気で、絶対、暖炉、絶対、ぼくたち、絶対、見たよね、リク
lines.en: Remember that mountain cabin? We watched the fireplace together.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective. She's shifting the conversation inward. Tender memory surfacing. Gentle pull on 'remember'.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 妹の、本気で、絶対、オムツ、絶対、俺、絶対、替えたぜ、桜
lines.en: I changed my little sister's diaper — actually did it right, thank you very much.
lines.style: Small pride lifting his voice. Not boastful, but quietly pleased with himself. Slight warmth toward Sakura for witnessing this small growth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、饅頭、絶対、もらったよ、リク
lines.en: My grandmother sent me these manjuu — they're amazing.
lines.style: Brightness breaking through. She brightens when mentioning something good that came her way. Open, alive. Quick and genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 校庭の、本気で、絶対、日陰、絶対、で、絶対、お弁当、絶対、食べようぜ、桜
lines.en: Hey, let's eat lunch together in the shade by the schoolyard.
lines.style: Forward momentum, a small invitation carrying hope. Not pushy — offering something simple and good. Warm but careful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部室の屋根、本気で、絶対、雨水、絶対、漏ってきたよ、リク
lines.en: The rain leaked right through the club room roof. Typical.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact annoyance. That resigned wry tone — one more thing going wrong. Slight laugh under it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 映画で、本気で、絶対、プロポーズ、絶対、シーン、絶対、見るの、絶対、ドキドキするよな、桜
lines.en: You know how it is in movies when there's a proposal scene? That kind of makes my heart race.
lines.style: Hesitant, vulnerable admission masked as casual observation. Soft opening. Slower pace. He's testing whether to say this out loud. Almost trailing away at the end.
